views.purpose: The diagram targets the seat booking functionality by using runtime components and connectors to answer how the main system components communicate and the order of calls during execution.
required_evidence: Runtime components involved in seat booking
Connectors and communication sequences between runtime parts
views.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML can cleanly represent runtime components and their interactive connectors for connectivity and control-flow questions.

notes: Eligible because they frame the chosen concerns: module-decomposition, context, cnc-runtime, code-mapping

Module-decomposition and code-mapping focus primarily on static structure rather than dynamic runtime communication and control-flow. System context is too high-level and boundary-focused to detail internal component interactions and call sequences.
